en.title: Caesar Cipher Shifting Right by Four
en.description:
Shift each uppercase letter 4 positions to the right in the English alphabet, cyclically, so that A follows Z, keeping the original order.

The input/output protocol was compiled by this site.
en.input: One line containing a string of length 1 to 100 consisting only of A to Z.
en.explanation: PINEAPPLE becomes TMRIETTPI; WXYZ becomes ABCD letter by letter; A becomes E.
hints: Convert the letters to 0 to 25, add 4, take the result modulo 26, and convert back to letters.
